description.p: Cast an artificer spell through this focus to add 1d8 to one damage roll.
The infused robe has 4 charges. It regains 1d4 expended charges each dawn.
This weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. The bonus increases to +2 when you reach 10th level in this class.
The focus grants a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. This bonus increases to +2 when you reach 10th level in this class.
Make a ranged spell attack that deals 1d10 radiant damage on a hit.
Targets make a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 lightning damage.
The lens emits colored light for 1d4 rounds. This spell deals no damage.
Make a ranged spell attack that deals 1d8 force damage on a hit.
